theorems.name: split_index_progress
theorems.doc: **S (U1 fix).** A non-empty line is always cut somewhere in `1..=len` (the loop makes progress; no slicing panic).
theorems.statement:
theorem split_index_progress (s : Slice Std.U8) (w : Std.Usize) (h : 0 < s.val.length) :
    ∃ k, split_index s w = ok k ∧ 1 ≤ k.val ∧ k.val ≤ s.val.length
theorems.proof:
theorem split_index_progress (s : Slice Std.U8) (w : Std.Usize) (h : 0 < s.val.length) :
    ∃ k, split_index s w = ok k ∧ 1 ≤ k.val ∧ k.val ≤ s.val.length := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, h1, h2, _⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (split_index_spec s w h)
  exact ⟨k, hk, h1, h2⟩

theorems.name: split_index_boundary
theorems.doc: **S (U1 fix).** The cut is a UTF-8 character boundary.
theorems.statement:
theorem split_index_boundary (s : Slice Std.U8) (w k : Std.Usize) (h0 : 0 < s.val.length)
    (h : split_index s w = ok k) : is_boundary s k = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem split_index_boundary (s : Slice Std.U8) (w k : Std.Usize) (h0 : 0 < s.val.length)
    (h : split_index s w = ok k) : is_boundary s k = ok true := by
  obtain ⟨k', hk, _, _, hb⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 (split_index_spec s w h0)
  rw [hk] at h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst h
  exact is_boundary_of_bnd s k' hb

theorems.name: chunk_end_progress
theorems.statement:
theorem chunk_end_progress (s : Slice Std.U8) (o n e : Std.Usize)
    (ho : o.val < s.val.length) (h : chunk_end s o n = ok e) : o.val < e.val ∧ e.val ≤ s.val.length
theorems.proof:
theorem chunk_end_progress (s : Slice Std.U8) (o n e : Std.Usize)
    (ho : o.val < s.val.length) (h : chunk_end s o n = ok e) : o.val < e.val ∧ e.val ≤ s.val.length := by
  have spec : chunk_end s o n ⦃ r => o.val < r.val ∧ r.val ≤ s.val.length ⦄ := by
    unfold chunk_end
    have hge : ¬ o ≥ Slice.len s := by scalar_tac
    simp only [hge, if_false]
    step*
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals (try split)
    all_goals (try step*)
    all_goals first
      | scalar_tac
      | (simp_all; done)
      | (simp_all; scalar_tac)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 spec
  rw [hr] at h
  simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at h
  subst h
  exact hp

theorems.name: printable_excludes_controls
theorems.doc: **S (U2 fix).** No C0 control byte (ESC, GS, FS, DLE...) and no DEL is printable.
theorems.statement:
theorem printable_excludes_controls (b : Std.U8) (h : b.val < 32 ∨ b.val = 127) :
    printable b = ok false
theorems.proof:
theorem printable_excludes_controls (b : Std.U8) (h : b.val < 32 ∨ b.val = 127) :
    printable b = ok false := by
  unfold printable SPACE DEL
  rcases h with h | h <;> simp <;> scalar_tac

chunk_end.lean:
def chunk_end
  (payload : Slice Std.U8) (offset : Std.Usize) (size : Std.Usize) :
  Result Std.Usize
  := do
  let len := Slice.len payload
  if offset >= len
  then ok len
  else
    let i ← len - offset
    let limit ← if size > i
                  then ok len
                  else offset + size
    let e ← floor_boundary payload limit
    if e > offset
    then ok e
    else let j ← offset + 1#usize
         chunk_end_loop payload len j

is_boundary.lean:
def is_boundary (s : Slice Std.U8) (i : Std.Usize) : Result Bool := do
  if i = 0#usize
  then let i1 := Slice.len s
       ok (i <= i1)
  else
    let i1 := Slice.len s
    if i >= i1
    then let i2 := Slice.len s
         ok (i <= i2)
    else
      let i2 ← Slice.index_usize s i
      if i2 < 128#u8
      then ok true
      else ok (i2 >= 192#u8)

printable.lean:
def printable (b : Std.U8) : Result Bool := do
  if b >= SPACE
  then ok (b != DEL)
  else ok false

floor_boundary.lean:
def floor_boundary (s : Slice Std.U8) (i : Std.Usize) : Result Std.Usize := do
  let i1 := Slice.len s
  let j ← if i > i1
            then ok (Slice.len s)
            else ok i
  floor_boundary_loop s j

split_index.lean:
def split_index
  (remaining : Slice Std.U8) (width : Std.Usize) : Result Std.Usize := do
  let len := Slice.len remaining
  if len = 0#usize
  then ok 0#usize
  else
    let take ← if width < len
                 then ok width
                 else ok len
    let take1 ← floor_boundary remaining take
    if take1 = 0#usize
    then split_index_loop0 remaining len 1#usize
    else split_index_loop1 remaining take1 take1
